name: verify-docs-action
description: GitHub Action to verify documentation is in sync with code using Claude

scripts.build: ncc build src/index.ts -o dist --minify --source-map --license licenses.txt && npm run copy-sdk-runtime
scripts.copy-sdk-runtime: cp node_modules/@anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk/cli.js dist/ && cp node_modules/@anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk/*.wasm dist/ && cp -R node_modules/@anthropic-ai/claude-agent-sdk/vendor dist/

author: Miguel Vila
